results.title: Liquid Time-constant Networks (Hasani et al., 2020)
results.content: Liquid time-constant networks (LTC) are continuous-time recurrent neural networks whose neurons are described by ODEs with input-dependent time constants. The 2020 paper by Hasani, Lechner et al. shows LTC networks are universal approximators on time-series and provably more expressive than fixed-time-constant RNNs.

results.title: MIT CSAIL — Liquid Networks Generalize From Less Data
results.content: MIT CSAIL researchers describe Liquid Neural Networks: small (sometimes 19-neuron) continuous-time models that adapt their parameters online while running. The networks were demoed steering autonomous drones in unseen forests with only ~20K training trajectories — orders of magnitude less data than the convolutional baselines.

results.title: ncps — Neural Circuit Policies (GitHub)
results.content: ncps is the reference Python library for Liquid Time-constant (LTC) networks and Closed-form Continuous-time (CfC) networks. Provides PyTorch and TensorFlow modules with named-cell wirings inspired by the C. elegans connectome. README covers installation, the LTCCell vs CfCCell tradeoff, and the AutonomousDriving notebook.
